now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Cat Hardy and Flint Marko are lovers who hope to settle down together. He turns away when he learns what she hid from him, but he protects her from Leyden, and Ben's last cure lets them be together.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Marko's lover, the singer he guards.

proposed.text: Flint Marko is Cat's bodyguard, and the two are lovers. When he goes missing, she hires Ben to find him.

split.title: Spider-Noir#4
split.text: Marko overhears Cat tell Ben she hired Addison to kill Silvermane so she and Marko could settle down. Feeling betrayed, he goes back to work for Silvermane.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Cat's lover, who turns away from her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Marko's lover, who kept her plot from him.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: When Leyden attacks Cat, Marko turns on him to protect her. Ben gives Marko the last dose of the cure so he and Cat can be together.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Cat's lover, cured so they can be together.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Marko's lover, whom he protects from Leyden.

changes.evidence: Whole-show stage starting at #1 tells later episodes: Cat's 'settle down with Marko' admission and Marko feeling betrayed is #4; Marko turning on Leyden after he attacks Cat and Ben giving Marko the last antidote dose so they can be together is #8. #1 only has Cat's bodyguard Marko fighting Ben and Cat hiring Ben to find Marko.

now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Silvermane owns the Alcove, where Cat sings, and he murdered her first fiance. She secretly plots against him, and in the end she tracks him down and kills him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The boss who murdered Cat's first fiance. Cat kills him in the end.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Silvermane's singer, who plots to kill him.

proposed.text: Cat sings at the Alcove, the nightclub Silvermane owns.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss who owns the club where Cat sings.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The singer at Silvermane's club, the Alcove.

split.title: Spider-Noir#3
split.text: Ben works out that Cat leaked Silvermane's liquor shipment and hired Addison to burn down his mansion.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss Cat secretly works against.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Silvermane's singer, who secretly works against him.

split.title: Spider-Noir#4
split.text: Cat reveals that Silvermane murdered her first fiance, and that she hired Addison to kill him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The boss who murdered Cat's first fiance.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Silvermane's singer, who plots to kill him.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: To protect Ben, Cat admits she betrayed Silvermane. When he flees, she tracks him down and kills him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The boss who murdered Cat's first fiance. Cat kills him.

changes.evidence: Whole-show stage starting at #1 names later reveals: Ben concludes Cat leaked the transfer and hired Addison in #3; the murdered first fiance is revealed in #4; Cat confessing her betrayal and tracking down and killing Silvermane is #8 (stage text and card A 'Cat kills him in the end').

now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Robbie digs into Silvermane's empire for his stories. At the Alcove, he arrives dressed as the Spider to stop Silvermane from killing Cat.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss Robbie investigates and tricks.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A journalist who poses as the Spider.

proposed.text: Robbie digs into Silvermane's empire for his stories.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A journalist digging into Silvermane's empire.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: When Silvermane is about to kill Cat at the Alcove, Robbie arrives dressed as the Spider.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss Robbie investigates and tricks.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A journalist who poses as the Spider.

changes.evidence: Whole-show stage starting at #1 tells the finale: Robbie arriving at the Alcove dressed as the Spider before Silvermane can kill Cat is #8.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
now.text: Martha is Curt's wife and a scientist herself, and they have a son, Billy. When Curt becomes the Lizard, she helps make the cure that turns him human again. Later the family leaves New York together to escape Miles Warren's blackmail.

proposed.text: Martha is Curt's wife and a scientist herself, and they have a son, Billy.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#3
split.text: When Curt becomes the Lizard, Martha helps make the cure that turns him human again.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#26
split.text: Curt and Martha leave ESU and New York with Billy to escape Miles Warren's blackmail.

changes.evidence: Whole-show stage starting at #1 tells later episodes: Connors becomes the Lizard and is cured with the gene cleanser in #3 (Natural Selection); the Connors pack up, leave ESU to Warren and fly to Florida in #26 (Final Curtain).

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#10
now.text: Black Cat knocks Mysterio out while helping Spider-Man stop the Chameleon's crime spree.

proposed.text: Black Cat knocks Quentin Beck out while helping Spider-Man stop the Chameleon's crime spree.

changes.evidence: In #10 (Persona) he is only the Chameleon's henchman Quentin Beck; he first takes the name Mysterio in #14 (Blueprints), so 'Mysterio' at #10 is a name from a later episode.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#10
now.text: Quentin Beck uses his effects skills to help the Chameleon frame Spider-Man, until Black Cat knocks him out.

changes.evidence: Card line calls him Mysterio at #10; he is Quentin Beck there and first becomes Mysterio in #14 (Blueprints). The stage text already says Quentin Beck.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#7
now.text: As the Green Goblin, Norman tries to overthrow Tombstone and become the city's crime boss.
now.on_a_card_about_b: As the Goblin, tries to overthrow Tombstone.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The crime boss Norman tries to overthrow.

proposed.text: The Green Goblin, a new masked villain, tries to overthrow Tombstone and become the city's crime boss.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The crime boss the Goblin tries to overthrow.

changes.evidence: At #7 the Goblin's identity is unknown (at #9 it is made to look like Harry); the Goblin is unmasked as Norman only in #26 (Final Curtain). Text and card B name Norman as the Goblin five episodes early.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#23
now.text: Norman secretly sets up the summit that brings Tombstone down. Then the Goblin takes over as the new Big Man.
now.on_a_card_about_b: As the Goblin, brings Tombstone down and takes over as the Big Man.

proposed.text: The Green Goblin secretly set up the summit that brings Tombstone down, and he takes over as the new Big Man.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The crime boss the Goblin overthrows.

changes.evidence: At the end of #23 (Gangland) the masked Goblin sits in Tombstone's chair and declares himself the new Big Man; he is revealed as Norman only in #26. Text and card B name Norman.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#9
now.text: Hammerhead accuses Norman of being the Goblin. The Goblin kidnaps him and dangles him over molten metal.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A thug Norman kidnaps as the Goblin.

changes.evidence: Card line says Norman kidnaps Hammerhead 'as the Goblin' at #9, but the Goblin is revealed as Norman only in #26 (in #9 the unmasked Goblin appears to be Harry).

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#22
now.text: Norman secretly steers Hammerhead into betraying Tombstone.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A thug Norman kidnaps and later manipulates.
now.on_b_card_about_a: As the Goblin, kidnaps Hammerhead and secretly plays him.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A thug Norman flatters into turning on Tombstone.

changes.evidence: Card line 'A thug Norman kidnaps and later manipulates' ties Norman to the Goblin's kidnapping at #22; that identity is revealed in #26. What Norman does openly in #22 is tell Hammerhead he has the qualities of a leader.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#25
now.text: The Green Goblin sabotages the Vault's security during Black Cat's attempt to free her father, and she ends up fighting him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A thief who fights Norman at the Vault.
now.on_b_card_about_a: As the Green Goblin, fights Black Cat at the Vault.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A thief who fights the Goblin at the Vault.

changes.evidence: At #25 (Opening Night) Black Cat fights the masked Goblin; the Goblin is revealed as Norman in #26, so 'fights Norman' gives the reveal away.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
now.text: Electro breaks out of Ravencroft to join the new Sinister Six and helps kidnap Gwen, until Spider-Man captures him again.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A living power surge Peter keeps fighting.

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#16
proposed.text: Electro breaks out of Ravencroft to join the new Sinister Six. He and the Vulture ambush Spider-Man, who traps Electro under a pile of tires.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
split.text: Electro helps kidnap Gwen for the Master Planner, and Spider-Man stops him again in the lair.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A living power surge Peter keeps fighting.

changes.evidence: Kraven breaks Electro out of Ravencroft and the new Sinister Six forms in #16 (Reinforcement), where Electro and the Vulture fight Spider-Man at the skating pond and he is trapped in tires; the Gwen kidnapping is #17 (Shear Strength).

owner_calls.question: The Spectacular Spider-Man's Green Goblin is unmasked as Norman only in #26, but his Goblin stages from #7 on sit on the 'Norman Osborn' entity (pairs with the Big Man, Hammerhead, Black Cat, Molten Man). If the card shows the name Norman Osborn at those stages, the reveal leaks whatever the wording. How should these show before #26?
options: Show the entity as 'Green Goblin' until #26 (name reveal)
Keep as is; only fix text that names Norman (done in this chunk)
Move the pre-#26 Goblin stages to a separate masked entity
owner_calls.evidence: #9 makes the Goblin look like Harry; #26 (Final Curtain) unmasks Norman. Molten Man #24 card A ('A pawn Norman turns into the Molten Man') was left as is because one fan source says Norman is present on screen at the injection.
